title: Master the Wind Waker baton early
body: It's the most-used tool in the game: Wind's Requiem changes the wind direction, the Ballad of Gales warps you across the sea, and the Command Melody activates statues. Learn each song as soon as you get it.

title: Upgrade your wallet before you start hoarding rupees
body: You start with capacity for only 200 rupees — not even enough for one Triforce Chart (Tingle charges 398). Visit Tingle on Rock Spire Isle as soon as you can.

title: Talk to everyone and read every sign
body: NPCs on each island and posted signs give the exact clue you need to decipher a Treasure Chart or find a nearby Piece of Heart — you almost never have to guess blindly.

title: Photograph everything you see
body: The Deluxe Picto Box feeds Carlov's Nintendo Gallery (134 possible figurines) and unlocks sidequests like Minenco's on Five-Star Isle.

title: The game only saves at golden statues
body: This guide's progress (hearts, charts, current island) saves automatically on your device — but the game itself only saves when you touch a golden statue. Don't close it without visiting one.

title: Beat the game once to unlock extras
body: Defeating Ganondorf unlocks the Swift Sail (the boat always sails at max speed) and Hero Mode, a tougher new playthrough.
